messages:
liam: kicking off idx_user_features backfill now — window open 02:00-05:00 UTC. plan: 0->5% at start, 5->50% over 40m, 50->100% in final hour. pinned migration version: mig/v5.3.2. Flagging safemode: enable `migration_slew_rate=true` if we hit latency.

deploybot: canary started for mig/v5.3.2 on shard group north-1 (canary-10%). logs: deploybot://canary/1772002468 started

ana: noted. I'll watch p99 and DB locks. @kai can you standby for possible unpin?

kai: oncall scope open. watching pgpool and backfill job queue. hooking up slow_query stream.

sophia: FYI release notes updated with rollback steps. snippet: `-- pause consumer
UPDATE migration_tasks SET state='paused' WHERE migration_id=\'mig/v5.3.2\';` will be used to pause consumer.

opsbot: alert configured: avg write latency > 200ms for 5m -> notify #oncall.

liam: starting ramp to 5% now. running command: `./run_backfill --mig mig/v5.3.2 --rate 5%`

deploybot: ramp to 5% complete. canary metrics: p50: 30ms, p95: 120ms, p99: 320ms. KV cache miss increased ~12%.

ana: p99 320ms is higher than expected. but within warning. continuing to 50%? we should hold if locks >5s.

kai: seeing one outlier on shard s-7 with 9s advisory lock. pausing ramp for 3m to observe. setting `migration_slew_rate=hold`.

liam: pause ACK. can we hotfix a retry backoff? There's a lot of small transactions piling up.

sophia: rolling change: decrease batch_size from 200 -> 100 for the job on s-7. I'll patch job config.

deploybot: applied config patch + redeployed worker pool to 2 replicas. redeploy id: dpl-8791

opsbot: redis queue depth spike on s-7 persisted 2m. suggesting backfill throttle to 10% for impacted shard.

liam: agree. issuing throttle: `./set_backfill_rate --shard s-7 --rate 10%`

deploybot: rate applied. p99 now 280ms after 90s. locks dropped to 2.1s.

ana: good improvement. propose continue gradual ramp to 50% but keep shard-level taper in place. If p99 > 400ms or lock >5s revert to pinned fallback model `mig/v5.2.9`.

kai: I'll prepare rollback steps and a fast-unpin command: `./unpin_migration mig/v5.3.2 --force --start-accepting=false`.

liam: ok proceed. moving to 50% in 20m. @everyone please ack for runway.

sophia: ack

ana: ack

kai: ack, watching

deploybot: ramp to 50% started. will post summary at 50% completion.
